skill.name: landing-page-design
skill.description: Create high-converting, visually distinctive landing pages. Use when building marketing pages, product launches, SaaS homepages, or single-page conversion websites. Guides discovery, section composition, visual direction, animation, and quality checks.
skill.summary: Guides AI agents through discovery, visual direction, page structure, and polish for distinctive conversion-focused landing pages.

content.value_statement: Generic landing pages fail to earn trust or attention. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through discovery, structure, visual direction, animation, and conversion-focused polish.
actual_capabilities: Runs a vibe discovery process before page construction.
Defines colors, typography, layout density, shapes, motion, and a wildcard detail.
Outlines landing page sections from hero to footer.
Suggests distinctive fonts, icon sets, color systems, and animation vocabulary.
Provides prompt patterns for hero generation, section additions, animation polish, and protected areas.
Includes quality checks for responsiveness, image loading, performance, contrast, and conversion clarity.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not production analytics or A/B testing results.
It depends on accurate brand context from the user.
It may reference external design inspiration that users must review for licensing and fit.
It does not guarantee conversions without traffic, offer quality, and user research.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS Homepage
use_cases.description: Create a focused landing page with a strong hero, clear value proposition, social proof, and conversion sections.

use_cases.title: Refresh a Campaign Page
use_cases.description: Use vibe discovery and section prompts to make a campaign page more distinctive and aligned with brand goals.

use_cases.title: Direct AI Page Builds
use_cases.description: Guide Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through layout, typography, motion, and polish decisions for a single-page site.

prompt_templates.title: Start Vibe Discovery
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new landing page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the landing page design skill. Ask me the required vibe discovery questions before writing any code.

prompt_templates.title: Build the Page Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt after the user provides brand context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a landing page plan for this product. Include hero, benefits, social proof, how it works, CTA, and footer sections.

prompt_templates.title: Strengthen Visual Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for improving a draft page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this landing page direction. Make the color palette, typography, layout, and motion more distinctive while keeping the conversion goal clear.

prompt_templates.title: Polish a Production Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a nearly complete page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this landing page for responsive layout, image quality, animation performance, color contrast, hierarchy, and CTA clarity. Return prioritized fixes.

output_examples.input: A founder asks for a landing page for a privacy-focused analytics product.
output_examples.output: A named visual direction, color palette, font pairing, hero approach, section order, motion style, and conversion checklist.

output_examples.input: A marketer wants a campaign page to avoid generic AI design patterns.
output_examples.output: A revised creative brief with anti-patterns, distinctive influences, stronger section prompts, and polish tasks for the AI agent.

output_examples.input: A developer has a draft page that feels flat on mobile.
output_examples.output: A prioritized design review covering hierarchy, spacing, responsive behavior, image use, animation restraint, and CTA placement.

best_practices: Answer the vibe discovery questions with specific places, emotions, and anti-patterns.
Spend extra time on the hero section because it shapes the full page direction.
Check mobile layout, contrast, images, animation performance, and CTA clarity before publishing.
anti_patterns: Starting with code before defining the visual direction and conversion goal.
Using default fonts, generic gradients, or repeated layouts without a clear reason.
Adding decorative motion or visuals that distract from the primary action.

faq.question: What type of pages does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create single-page landing pages for products, launches, SaaS homepages, campaigns, and conversion-focused websites.

faq.question: Does it write production code?
faq.answer: It guides an AI agent through planning, design direction, section prompts, and quality checks. Code generation depends on the active agent.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require brand guidelines?
faq.answer: No. It can start from simple context questions, but stronger brand details improve the result.

faq.question: What makes it different from a generic landing page prompt?
faq.answer: It requires a named vibe, concrete influences, anti-patterns, section structure, animation choices, and a quality checklist.

faq.question: Does it guarantee higher conversion rates?
faq.answer: No. It improves design and structure, but conversion depends on the offer, audience, traffic quality, and testing.
